title: PH targets $5-M UN fund to tackle 'super pollutants'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna has formally confirmed the Philippines’ application for a major global accelerator program to curb super pollutants, while offering to host an international climate leadership board meeting in Manila next year. Meeting with Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) Secretariat Head Martina Otto at the United Nations Headquarters on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly, the top official reaffirmed the nation’s commitment to advancing clean air, public health, and climate resilience.
